title: Datadog Application key (legacy 40-hex): one-property twin (context) (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context: the DD_APPLICATION_KEY marker replaced by BUILD_COMMIT; the value is unchanged and context: the same-line DD_APPLICATION_KEY marker replaced by GIT_COMMIT_SHA, an ordinary 40-hex companion; the value is unchanged. Twin of "Datadog Application key (legacy 40-hex): must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of datadog-application-key-legacy-actions-env: context: the DD_APPLICATION_KEY marker replaced by BUILD_COMMIT; the value is unchanged. The value is unchanged and exactly one property of the assignment context differs; expected silence is project policy, as the positive's expectation is.
